verdict.rationale: n8n is a workflow automation tool with documented event-driven triggers: a Webhook node, an error workflow that fires when an execution fails, and community reports of scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks running in production. The evidence does not document how conditional rules are defined, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of rule/condition logic (e.g. IF/filter nodes) for deciding which actions fire, substantive trigger docs beyond node titles, and a documented catalog of event trigger types.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: n8n is a fair-code licensed workflow automation tool that combines AI features with business process automation.
With an error workflow, you can control how n8n responds to a workflow execution failure.
I use it to follow subreddits, scrape posts, analyze based on arbitrary criteria, note the findings in a spreadsheet, then send a notification.
